cue: Take an inhale, and as you exhale gently roll your head to the right. Inhale back to centre, and exhale over to the left.
Take an inhale here. As you exhale, draw the belly in and gently tilt the pelvis, pressing the lower back towards the floor. Inhale to release.
Inhale the knees to centre. Exhale, let the knees fall to the right as the head turns to the left. Inhale back to centre, and change sides.
Extend your left leg and hug your right knee in towards you. As you exhale, gently draw the thigh a little closer towards the belly.
Change sides, extending the right leg and drawing the left knee in. Use your exhale to gently bring the thigh closer towards you.
Hug both knees in towards you and give yourself a squeeze. Keep the head relaxed and gently draw the thighs towards the belly.
Bring the knees over the hips, draw the belly down and bring your hands to your head. Exhale, extend the right leg and bring the right elbow towards the left knee.
Inhale through centre. Exhale, extend the left leg and bring the left elbow towards the right knee.
Place your right ankle across your left thigh and flex the right foot. Draw the left leg in towards you, relaxing the shoulders as you gently press the right knee away.
Release and change sides. Draw the right leg towards you, flex the left foot and gently encourage the left knee away.
Wrists underneath the shoulders, knees underneath the hips. Inhale, drop the belly, lift the chest and lift the sit bones.
Exhale, press into the hands, round the spine and draw the belly in.
Inhale, reach the left arm forwards and extend the right leg back. Exhale, round through the spine and draw elbow and knee in towards the belly.
Inhale, reach the right arm forwards and extend the left leg back. Exhale, round through the spine and draw elbow and knee in towards the belly.
Curl the toes under, press firmly through the hands and lift the hips high. Bend the knees as much as you need to and find length through the spine.
Stand tall, ground down through your feet, draw the tailbone down and gently tone the belly in and up. Relax the shoulders and find your breath.
Inhale, sweep the arms up and take hold of your left wrist. Exhale, reach over towards the right, pressing firmly through the left foot and keeping the shoulders relaxed.
Come back through centre and change your grip. Exhale, reach over towards the left, pressing firmly through the right foot and keeping the ribs drawing in.
Inhale, sweep the arms up and gaze towards the thumbs.
Exhale, fold forwards, bending the knees as much as you need.
Inhale, halfway lift and lengthen through the spine.
Exhale, plant the hands, step back and lower with control. Drop the knees if you need to.
Inhale, lift the chest into Cobra or Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog. Press firmly through the hands and lengthen through the spine.
Look forwards, step or jump to the hands. Inhale, halfway lift and lengthen.
Exhale and fold.
Inhale, root down through the feet and sweep the arms all the way up.
Exhale, release the arms down alongside the body.
Bend the knees and dip the hips. Inhale, sweep the arms up into Chair.
Exhale, fold forwards and bring the hands to the floor.
Inhale, halfway lift and lengthen the spine.
Plant the hands, step back and exhale, lower with control.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, roll over the toes and lift the hips into Downward-Facing Dog.
Step your right foot forwards, turn the back heel down and inhale, rise into Warrior One.

Straighten the front leg and open the arms. Inhale, reach forwards through the right fingertips; exhale, bring the right hand down and the left arm up. Press through both feet, draw the belly in and open the chest towards the ceiling.
Look down and inhale, come all the way up. Rest the left hand lightly on the back leg and reach the right arm up and over, keeping both legs strong.

Come back through centre and turn the back foot slightly forwards. Square the hips, inhale and lengthen forwards; exhale, bring the left hand down and begin to turn the chest towards the right. Once you have the rotation, reach the right arm up.
Bring both hands down, step back and exhale, lower through Chaturanga.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.
Step your left foot forwards, turn the back heel down and inhale, rise into Warrior One.

Straighten the front leg and open the arms. Inhale, reach forwards through the left fingertips; exhale, bring the left hand down and the right arm up. Press through both feet, draw the belly in and open the chest towards the ceiling.
Look down and inhale, come all the way up. Rest the right hand lightly on the back leg and reach the left arm up and over, keeping both legs strong.

Come back through centre and turn the back foot slightly forwards. Square the hips, inhale and lengthen forwards; exhale, bring the right hand down and begin to turn the chest towards the left. Once you have the rotation, reach the left arm up.
Bring both hands down, step back and exhale, lower through Chaturanga.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.

Step the right foot forwards, turn the back heel down and inhale, rise into Warrior One. Bend deeply into the front knee, press firmly through the back foot and relax the shoulders away from the ears.
Exhale, open out into Warrior Two. Reach strongly through both arms, bend into the front knee and keep the knee tracking over the ankle.

Inhale, straighten the front leg and give it a moment. Exhale, re-bend the knee, bring the forearm to the thigh and reach the top arm up and over. Press into the floor rather than sinking into the hip.

Look down and inhale, come all the way up. Turn the feet parallel, bring the hands to the hips and lengthen the spine. Exhale, fold forwards from the hips and let the crown of the head reach towards the floor.
Turn the left toes out, bend into the left knee and inhale, rise into Warrior One. Press firmly through the back foot and relax the shoulders down.
Exhale, open out into Warrior Two. Reach strongly through both arms, bend into the front knee and keep the knee tracking over the ankle.
Inhale, straighten the front leg. Exhale, re-bend the knee, bring the forearm to the thigh and reach the top arm up and over. Press into the floor and keep length through both sides of the waist.
Straighten the front leg and turn the feet parallel. Interlace the hands behind your back, inhale and open the chest. Exhale, fold forwards and let the arms travel up and over the head.
Bring the hands down, step back and exhale, lower with control.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.
Ground firmly through your right foot and bring your left foot to wherever feels comfortable — thigh, calf or toes to the floor. Bring the hands to prayer, stand tall and draw the tailbone down.

Bring your left knee forwards through centre, then slowly float the leg back behind you into Warrior Three. Square the hips, draw the belly in and lengthen from the crown of the head through the back heel.
Bring your right hand to the floor or a block. Keep the back leg strong and begin to open the left hip and shoulder, reaching the left arm up towards the ceiling.

Slowly bring the back foot down about a leg's length behind you and square the hips forwards. Inhale, lengthen the spine; exhale, fold over the right leg, bending the front knee if you need to keep the spine long.
Bring the hands down, step back and exhale, lower with control.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.
Ground firmly through your left foot and bring your right foot to wherever feels comfortable. Bring the hands to prayer, stand tall and draw the tailbone down.
Bring your right knee forwards through centre, then slowly float the leg back behind you into Warrior Three. Square the hips, draw the belly in and lengthen through the whole body.
Bring your left hand to the floor or a block. Keep the back leg strong and begin to open the right hip and shoulder, reaching the right arm up.
Bring the back foot down about a leg's length behind you and square the hips forwards. Inhale to lengthen; exhale, fold over the left leg with a long spine.
Inhale, reach the arms up. Sweep the right arm back and take hold of the inside of the right foot. Focus your eyes on one point and begin to kick the foot back as the left arm reaches forwards.
Inhale, reach the arms up. Sweep the left arm back and take hold of the inside of the left foot. Focus your eyes on one point and begin to kick the foot back as the right arm reaches forwards.
From Downward Dog, step the right foot forwards and lower the back knee. Walk the right foot slightly wider, let the hips grow heavy and keep reaching the chest forwards.
Begin to send the hips back and straighten through the right leg. Flex the foot, inhale to lengthen the spine and exhale to fold forwards only as far as you can keep that length.
Bring the right knee forwards and extend the left leg back behind you. Settle the hips towards the floor, inhale to lengthen through the spine and exhale, begin to fold forwards.
Come up and turn to face the long edge of the mat. Take the legs wide, flex the feet and sit tall. Inhale to lengthen; exhale, tilt forwards from the hips, keeping the spine long.
Bring the hands down, step back and exhale, lower with control.
Inhale, open the chest into Upward-Facing Dog.
Exhale, lift the hips up and back into Downward-Facing Dog.
From Downward Dog, step the left foot forwards and lower the back knee. Walk the left foot slightly wider, let the hips grow heavy and keep reaching the chest forwards.
Send the hips back and straighten through the left leg. Flex the foot, inhale to lengthen and exhale to fold forwards with a long spine.
Bring the left knee forwards and extend the right leg back behind you. Settle the hips, inhale to find length and exhale, begin to fold forwards.
Turn to face the long edge of the mat. Take the legs wide and flex the feet. Inhale, sit tall; exhale, fold forwards from the hips without rounding through the spine.

Walk the feet in behind the hands, hands shoulder-distance apart. Bend the elbows and place the knees onto the backs of the arms. Look slightly forwards and begin to shift your weight into your hands, perhaps lifting one foot and then the other.
Bring the shoulders underneath the thighs and plant the hands firmly beside the feet. Squeeze the legs into the arms, shift the weight forwards and see if the feet become light.
Keep pressing firmly through the hands and lifting through the hips. If it's available, begin to extend the legs forwards while keeping the inner thighs squeezing into the arms.
Bring the hands underneath the shoulders. Inhale, gently lift the head and chest, keeping the elbows drawing back and the shoulders away from the ears.
Bring the arms alongside the body and the legs long behind you. Inhale, lift the head, chest, arms and legs away from the floor and keep reaching long through the body.
Bend the knees and take hold of the ankles. Inhale, kick the feet back into the hands and let that action lift the chest and thighs away from the floor.
Bring the feet to the floor, hip-width apart. Press firmly into the feet and inhale, lift the hips. Keep the knees drawing forwards and the chest lifting towards the chin.
Bring the hands beside the ears, fingers pointing towards the feet. Press firmly through the hands and feet and begin to lift the hips and chest away from the floor.
Bring the hips back towards the heels and let the forehead come down. Soften through the shoulders, the neck and the jaw, and breathe into the back of the body.
Extend the right leg and bring the sole of the left foot into the inner thigh. Inhale, reach up and lengthen the spine; exhale, fold forwards over the right leg.
Change sides. Inhale, sit tall and reach up; exhale, fold forwards over the left leg, keeping length through the spine.
Extend the right leg and fold the left leg back beside you. Ground through both sit bones, inhale to lengthen and exhale, fold forwards over the straight leg.
Change sides, extending the left leg and folding the right leg back. Inhale to find length; exhale, fold forwards over the straight leg.
Extend both legs forwards and flex the feet. Inhale, sweep the arms up and lengthen; exhale, fold forwards from the hips, reaching towards the feet.

english: Half Lord of the Fishes — Right
cue: Bring the right foot across the left leg and ground both sit bones. Inhale, lengthen through the spine; exhale, draw the belly in and gently twist towards the right.

english: Half Lord of the Fishes — Left
cue: Change sides and ground both sit bones. Inhale, sit tall; exhale, draw the belly in and gently rotate towards the left.
Lie back and begin to lift the legs and hips. Bring the hands to support the back, press firmly through the upper arms and shoulders and reach the legs up towards the ceiling.
Bring the knees above the hips and stretch the arms wide. Exhale, slowly lower the knees towards the right and gently turn the head to the left, keeping the opposite shoulder grounded.
Inhale the knees back through centre. Exhale, lower them towards the left and gently turn the head to the right.
Extend the legs out along the mat and let the arms rest beside you. Give the weight of your body to the floor, soften the forehead and jaw, and allow the breath to settle.
